question: President shall from time to time summon each House of Parliament to meet at such time and place as he thinks fit, but ______ months shall not intervene between its last sitting in one session and the date appointed for its first sitting in the next session.
solution:
The correct answer is __**six**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to **Article 85(1) of the Indian Constitution**, the President has the power to summon each House of Parliament to meet at such time and place as he thinks fit. However, the **gap between two sessions** of Parliament should not exceed **six months**.
 
• This provision ensures that Parliament meets regularly and there are no prolonged gaps between sessions, allowing for continuous legislative and executive oversight.
 
• The **Constitutional mandate** to maintain a maximum interval of six months between two sessions of Parliament is intended to uphold the democratic process and accountability of the government.
 
• The **three sessions of Parliament** traditionally held each year are: the Budget Session (February-May), Monsoon Session (July-September), and Winter Session (November-December).
